localGuidance: Flutter caller helper with native Android integration. ERP owns business data and SQL; Auth owns browser identity. Preserve PKCE, tenant scope, foreground/lock-screen boundaries and release signing identity. Read README.md. Commands: ./gradlew :app:testDebugUnitTest :app:lintDebug, npm test, npm run quality:check. Real-device and incoming-call acceptance is separate from automated tests.

README.md.purpose: Android app, server prerequisites, release and acceptance contract

android/app/src/test/java/ro/chimeraerp/.behavior: Canonical per-caller cursor restoration, active-call retention and 30-minute inactivity expiry, stale reply and login boundaries

android/app/src/test/java/ro/chimeraerp/.behavior: Android15 simulated service: real overlay attachment, refusal diagnostics, canonical lookup, locked/unlocked context, sticky opt-in and network failure; outside-tap minimization retains one embedded panel without launching an activity

test/assist_test.dart.behavior: Cloud/enterprise privacy, setup/tests, narrow partner actions, session-loss late replies and visible error/empty states

android/app/src/test/java/ro/chimeraerp/.behavior: Launch the real AppAuth redirect receiver with merged Android resources for successful and rejected browser responses; forward unchanged callback to the authorization manager without crashing

android/app/src/test/java/ro/chimeraerp/.behavior: Concurrent renewal runs once; logout and changed login cannot be overwritten or borrowed by stale requests

test/workspace_test.dart.behavior: Inline lists/details/pagination, caller A-B-A restoration, stale responses, minimized context, loading/empty/error and large-text layout
